title: Same weights, 2.x vs 3.x: different registry_hash
asserts: 3.0.0 applies the same four weights as 2.0.0, value for value, but its registry_hash also covers the canonical band table, so it differs. The 3.x hash is pinned and equals SHA-256 of a hand-written byte string; moving a multiplier moves it, review status does not. Dedicated test.
